_comment: Expected verdicts for the RFC 4475 torture corpus.
Each entry was read off the prose of its section, not inferred from the
section number: 3.1.1.6 sits under 'Valid Messages' yet its text says the
grammar is buggy, and 3.1.2.2 is under 'Invalid Messages' yet describes a
framing delay rather than a syntax error.
well-formed       parser must accept, no error-severity diagnostic
semantic-rejected grammar ok, but a semantic rule must fire
policy            verdict depends on the element's role; not asserted

vectors.note: whitespace everywhere: folded lines, HCOLON spaces, odd case
unknown method, widest legal token/URI character range
% escaping in user, addr params, no recursive unescape
%00 in user part; must not shorten the AOR
% that is not an escape; C%6Fntact is not Contact
no LWS before < is an RFC 3261 grammar bug; must accept
very long header values and params
two messages in one datagram; first parses, remainder is trailing
semicolon params inside the URI user part
known and unknown transport types in Via
multipart/mime body; NOTE: the RFC's Content-Length (553) is 14 octets shorter than the hex body it prints, so the last 14 octets fall outside the declared body
unusual reason phrase characters
empty reason phrase, trailing SP still required
;;,;,, separators without parameters; grammar admits the value, the separator rule rejects it
Content-Length larger than the datagram: incomplete, not ill-formed
negative Content-Length is not 1*DIGIT
CSeq/Max-Forwards/Expires beyond their ranges
response scalar fields with overlarge values
unterminated quoted string in display name
<> around the Request-URI
embedded LWS inside the Request-URI
multiple SP between Request-Line elements
SP at the end of the Request-Line
escaped headers in the Request-URI must not be treated as headers
Date timezone must be GMT; UT/UTC/UCT are invalid
Contact addr-spec with URI headers must use angle brackets
spaces inside < >
unquoted display name containing non-token characters
SIP/3.0 parses as a version but is not supported
start-line method != CSeq method
unknown method plus CSeq mismatch
status code outside 100..699; must not crash the receiver
z9hG4bK branch with no identifier
missing required header fields
Request-URI with an unknown scheme
Request-URI with a known but unsupported scheme
unknown URI scheme in To: proxies forward, a registrar 400s
Proxy-Require/Require with unsupported options
unknown Content-Type: a proxy forwards, an endpoint 415s
unknown Authorization scheme is not a parse error
multiple values in single-valued headers
multiple Content-Length values
broadcast Via in a 200: routing policy, not a parse defect
Max-Forwards: 0 is legal; 483 is a forwarding decision
Contact header parameter on REGISTER
url-parameter on REGISTER
REGISTER with a URL-escaped Route header
unacceptable Accept offering: endpoint 406, proxy forwards
RFC 2543 syntax, no Max-Forwards: backward compatible
